title: PID_Compact gives KP times the error, negative errors included, limited to OUT_MIN and OUT_MAX
note: Not an IEC block: with KI and KD 0 the output is KP * (SP - PV) limited to OUT_MIN..OUT_MAX: PV 0 gives 20, PV 15 gives -10, PV 100 would give -180 and is limited to -100, PV -100 would give 220 and is limited to 100
